description.raw: Tasi summons a dream that lasts for 3.5 + 0.5 (SP-based)s, hypnotizing all enemies. Hypnotized enemies cannot move or act and take 70% (ATK-based) + 12% (SP-based) damage per second.
active: Tasi summons a dream that lasts for 3.5 + 0.5 (SP-based)s, hypnotizing all enemies.
Hypnotized enemies cannot move or act and take 70% (ATK-based) + 12% (SP-based) damage per second.

description.raw: Tasi consumes 10% of her current HP to deal damage equal to 110% + 10% (SP-based) of her consumed HP to adjacent enemies, stunning them for 0.5s. The damage dealt will be no less than 60% (ATK-based). She then flies to the farthest enemy and applies the same effect to adjacent enemies. However, the second hit on the same enemy will deal only 50% of the original damage.

text: Increases damage to 120% + 10% (SP-based) of her consumed HP.
Increases damage to 130% + 10% (SP-based) of her consumed HP.
Increases damage to 140% + 10% (SP-based) of her consumed HP.

description.raw: Tasi enters her dream realm and transforms into a butterfly upon losing 50% (HP-based) HP. In this form, she becomes invincible, recovering 120% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) HP per second while dealing 45% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies. This effect lasts for 3s, and Tasi can cast this skill up to 2 times in one battle.

description.raw: Tasi increases her ATK by 9% during battle. After casting Eternal Dreamscape, she gains an extra 6% ATK while the dream lasts.

description.raw: Tasi gains 70 Haste and reduces damage taken by 90% for 5s after casting Eternal Dreamscape. During this time, Dream Dance no longer costs Tasi's HP to cast and has no cooldown. Its damage counts as if Tasi had consumed 10% of her current HP, and she will prioritize targeting the farthest hypnotized enemy.
